reviews.text: I get the want to help people stay in shape, but saying that plus size is bad in one of your ads is not nice. I think the people should just be positive with their body type. If you think differently that’s fine but I would like you to modify the ad.

reviews.title: Didn’t want app, not used
reviews.text: I was told after trial that notice would be given to enable me to cancel trial. I used 1 day of trial. Notice not given. Am now paying for something I don’t use.

reviews.title: Doesn't meet targets set
reviews.text: When I signed up for this I was asked what my objectives were and my main one was to lose a bit of weight around my tummy. The app promised, with visuals showing my tummy rapidly disappearing, that I would lose my tummy within a month or two of starting the fitness routine. Having done this workout for about two months now, I can say with absolute certainty that there is NO CHANCE of losing any weight from my middle. Most of the time, I am moving only my arms. A routine which rarely moves the legs or the lower part of my body will not address tummy weight issues. The only reason I have given this app a rating of 2 and not 1 is that an unintended benefit has been to relieve soreness around my right shoulder joint because of the number of arm exercises covered in the routines. Very disappointing. I would not recommend

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Disappointed with app, boring exercises and not helpful or progressive.

reviews.title: Outrageous
reviews.text: This company has just taken an massive amount of money from my account without any explanation. Beware

reviews.title: Annoying to have to pay so soon
reviews.text: Was hoping for a free app to motivate me to do a little bit of exercise daily. For the first couple of days it was great, reminded me to do some exercise and shows you exactly how to do each exercise. But when you get to day 4 of any of the workouts, it wants you to pay for premium and you can’t do any more. I would rather be able to do the full 30 day work out that was promised in the adverts without paying and then I may be more likely to pay to continue. It’s a shame, as I quite liked the app itself, I just don’t want to pay for a full year when I’m not sure that I’d keep it up
